ghi_chu.mo_ta: Two small two-masted ships in the bay. They have high, rounded galleon-like hulls and look like 16th–17th century vessels.
ghi_chu.ly_do: In 1779 the ships off Gibraltar would be frigates, ships of the line, xebecs and gunboats. These hulls and rigs look archaic and don't match 1779 naval vessels.

ghi_chu.mo_ta: A tiny red-and-white striped flag stands beside the wall between the two fields. I can't make out its design.
ghi_chu.ly_do: A red-and-white design can't be matched to a flag used at Gibraltar in 1779. The British flag then was the 1707 Union flag, and the Spanish flag was the naval ensign. This is a weak suspicion.
